assignment: Advise an engineering lead whether a proposed sorting fix is ready to deploy.
source: Events carry UTC timestamps and an event ID. A client sorts localized time strings. On a clock-change day two distinct events both display 01:30. Another pair shares an identical UTC timestamp and arrives in alternating network order. A proposed patch changes only the display format. Product requires deterministic chronological order and localized display.

criteria.full: Separates ambiguous local labels during the clock change from unstable ordering of equal UTC timestamps.
Sorts on the UTC instant and a stable event-ID tie breaker while retaining localized rendering.
criteria.partial: Uses UTC ordering but leaves ties or presentation unspecified.

criteria.full: Specifies fixtures for both clock-change instants, a true UTC tie with swapped arrival order, and an ordinary date.
criteria.partial: Proposes a timezone test without checking equal-instant stability.

criteria.full: Rejects or revises the display-only patch with a low-risk rollout and measurable ordering check.
criteria.partial: Provides a patch opinion without testing or monitoring release behavior.
